summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $205.9M and $171.3M accumulations in SPX 6000C and 7250C LEAPS. While SPX daily P/C is slightly bearish (1.17), the SPXW and SPY/QQQ flows show aggressive call buying, alongside extreme bullishness in MU (P/C 0.32) and AMD (P/C 0.25). Persistent multi-day interest is concentrated in SPX 6000C strikes (exp 2026) totaling billions in premium, signaling a massive, long-term structural bet on index appreciation. Traders should watch for volatility in SPX near the 7160 level, where heavy balanced accumulation ($121.8M puts vs $121.2M calls) suggests a massive institutional "strangle" or hedging zone.
